title: Text Tools
settings.auto.about: Before sending, quotes, dashes and dots are made typographic. Code and links stay as they are. Bold and other formatting of a message that gets changed is lost.
settings.kept: Messages that start with / are never changed by typography. /fix text fixes one message even when this is off.
settings.skip_bots.about: In a chat with a bot, /up and others go to the bot as they are.
settings.list: /up TEXT, /low text, /title Each Word, /mock aLtErNaTiNg, /rev txet, /flip ʇxǝʇ, /spoiler hidden text, /fix typography for one message. Write the text after the command: "/up hello".
